title: Start with recorded evidence
transcript: Welcome to TraceHarness. The workbench has two connected jobs: inspect recorded agent runs, and configure new harness experiments. Open Datasets to choose recorded evidence, then Analysis to compare model and harness families. Open a trajectory to see what actually happened. Recorded results are a snapshot, not a claim that a new task is running now.

title: See the whole harness
transcript: Open Harnesses to choose the runtime, model, task and prompt. A stock stand-in and a native coding agent are different engines. Full harness JSON shows the complete current configuration. Expand Edit configuration JSON, inspect your changes, then choose Apply JSON. A recorded run has its own saved manifest. Your current draft never rewrites that history.

title: Build a bounded experiment
transcript: In Experiment matrix, capture each harness you want to compare. Select compatible models and registered tasks, then inspect every expanded cell. Set repetitions and an aggregate budget that covers all trial caps. Review the manifests and freeze the plan. Freezing is free. Connect your OpenRouter key and start only when you intend to execute. Keep the connection until the runner confirms completion or cancellation.

title: Read outcomes honestly
transcript: The results queue separates execution state from the independent task grade. A completed schedule can include failures. Open a job to inspect its full manifest, reported tokens, cost and verified artifacts. Missing cost is unknown, not zero. A confirmed refusal before any provider call reports zero. Reload and export the results without reconnecting a key. Small comparisons do not establish a general performance improvement.

title: Ask Buddy for the next step
transcript: Ask Buddy how to edit a harness, select tasks, schedule an experiment, or inspect a result. The workflow guide matches your question to documented capabilities and gives numbered steps. Choose Open to visit the relevant controls. Buddy will explain when a workflow needs the local runner or a compatible registered task. Guidance does not call a model, save your draft, or start a paid run. You stay in control.
